visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a light blue camisole, stands in a brightly lit modern kitchen. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy and expansive hand gestures. In the background, an older woman with short permed hair and red-framed glasses is seen working at a sink. (2) A macro shot focuses on a polished silver water dispenser faucet with a black digital touchscreen on top. Clear water flows steadily from the spout into a transparent glass held by a hand. Yellow warning icons are visible on the faucet base. (3) The older woman is now the focus, smiling and holding the glass of water while gesturing with her free hand. She is wearing a white patterned blouse and floral skirt. The kitchen has white tiled walls and light-colored countertops. (4) A man wearing a black suit jacket, white t-shirt, and glasses enters the frame. He stands next to the first woman, and they interact near the sink. The lighting is bright and consistent with a studio setup. (5) The woman is shown struggling with a large, traditional white electric kettle, pouring water into it from a pitcher. The scene then cuts back to her effortlessly pressing buttons on the modern silver dispenser. (6) A close-up shows the man opening a cabinet door under the sink to reveal a white rectangular Honeywell filtration unit. He demonstrates how to interact with the device. (7) The final segment features the man and woman standing together, pointing enthusiastically at the camera. Rapid editing intercuts their reactions with large text overlays and graphic effects like pink hearts and digital glitches.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-energy electronic pop music starts instantly. A high-pitched female voice speaks with rapid excitement. The acoustic environment is clean and dry. (2) A clear liquid splashing sound occurs for two seconds, indicating water flow. The music continues with a steady 4/4 beat. (3) A second female voice enters, sounding more mature and calm with a mid-range pitch, contrasting with the energetic primary speaker. (4) A low-pitched male voice introduces himself with professional clarity. A 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition in the narrative flow. (5) High-frequency digital 'beeps' are heard as the female voice discusses technical features. The BGM remains constant in the background. (6) A sharp 'record scratch' sound effect creates a comedic pause, followed by a burst of female laughter and exaggerated vocal expressions. (7) The BGM volume increases during a fast-paced promotional wrap-up. Multiple 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the dialogue at a high density.
